Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Experimental discovery of spontaneous electronic chirality in a correlated system, relevant to user's TRSB interests.

Tags: #experiment #URhSn #electronic-order

Abstract: The first direct evidence of spontaneous electronic chiral order in URhSn, a strongly correlated material without an inherently chiral lattice structure, fundamentally challenges the prevailing notion that electronic chirality requires a chiral crystal framework.
